title: Street Lights - Opening Scene

shots.title: Wide Establishing
shots.prompt: Cinematic high-angle shot looking down on a rain-soaked city street at night, multiple police cars with flashing red and blue lights lined up on both sides, their lights reflecting vividly on the wet asphalt pavement, dramatic moody atmosphere, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, 35mm anamorphic lens, 8K quality, photorealistic

shots.prompt: Young Black male rapper named Josh with long red dreadlocks, wearing a black BAPE shark t-shirt and khaki pants, multiple silver cuban link chains with cross pendants, holding a vintage silver microphone, standing in the middle of a rain-soaked street at night, police car lights flashing red and blue reflecting all around him and on the wet pavement, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, confident expression, eyes closed singing, photorealistic, 35mm anamorphic lens
